literal_meaning: এখন-তখন অবস্থা (now-then condition, implying fluctuating or uncertain state)
figurative_meaning_en: Fear of death every moment; on the verge of dying; moribund
example_sentences_in_bangla: রোগীর এখন-তখন অবস্থা দেখে সকলে চিন্তিত হয়ে পড়েছে।
যুদ্ধের সময় সৈনিকেরা এখন-তখন অবস্থায় ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: The patient's touch-and-go condition has everyone worried.
During the war, the soldiers were in a touch-and-go situation.
note: This idiom is commonly used in contexts of severe illness or life-threatening situations in Bengali culture.
